name: attention_only_looping

formal_training.checkpoint: latest500 overwrites; best separate; exit85 every1800s, same run ID on resume
formal_training.baseline: No additional formal baseline authorized; earlier Triton baseline has a different attention backend

attention_backend: FA3 required, original nanochat CausalSelfAttention; no FLA
parameter_sharing: Q/K/V/O shared across passes within each block, not across layers
recurrence: Each pass x <- x + attention(norm(x)); recompute Q/K/V from refined x. Then x <- x + MLP(norm(x)). No detach or extra parameter.
window_api: FA3 left=127, right=0; includes self so exactly128 visible keys
limitations: Initial implementation vanilla mean-only original attention; no combined NS/statistics/mHC experiment
Cached decoding explicitly rejected because it needs separate per-loop caches; full-prefix evaluation remains causal
Same parameter count does not imply same FLOPs, memory, or latency

validation.local_forward_and_vjp: Independent FP32 dense reference with BF16 inputs/outputs
validation.integrated: 2/3/4-pass ordering and gradients, single MLP, exact support, 2K causality, compile/checkpoint, initialization/RNG/optimizer sharing, checkpoint restoration
validation.regression: Retained FLA none/variance/SiLU kernel forward/VJP/model tests and saved-state tests; no FLA in looping
validation.profile: Same GPU baseline/loop in both orders, 20 warmup +30 timed full optimizer steps, micro16 accum1, fixed dev
validation.restart: 25 steps -> exit85 -> fresh process ->50; horizon305176, local logging only, no returned weights

fa3.policy: Worker fetches pinned module once; later processes offline. Record artifact SHA256 and profiler kernel names; reject fallback.
